method: Repository-wide structure and canonical-contract inspection plus cross-layer capability-gap comparison. Existing internal capabilities were compared against the public control surface so hidden-but-implemented primitives are distinguished from speculative new features.

high_value_findings.evidence: Desktop Fabric and Desktop Agent already support CPU/GPU/HYBRID, GPU inventory, VRAM, gpu_limit_percent and GPU telemetry while the public Router exposed only one CPU slider and receipts marked gpu:false.
high_value_findings.action: Expose explicit CPU/GPU/HYBRID/MAX user-cap profiles and GPU percent on the public evaluation surface without claiming browser GPU execution.
Drive local Reel Route Aura strength from the explicit CPU/GPU resource envelope and emit deterministic local sparks only when both configured caps are at maximum and compute is ACTIVE.

high_value_findings.existing_primitive: createRoutingPlan allocations[] with positive weights summing to one
high_value_findings.proposal: ALLOCATION_MIXER: explicit split such as SCIENCE 60% + MARKET 40%, with a single consent envelope, provider-capacity admission and visible audited sink split.
RESOURCE_GOVERNOR: optional Advanced panel for temperature ceiling, watt cap, battery/AC-only operation and concurrency.
high_value_findings.benefit: Turns consent from a simple percentage into a real device-safety contract.

high_value_findings.proposal: CAPABILITY_AWARE_ROUTE_CARDS: show CPU/GPU/HYBRID preference, VRAM class and required capability tags before consent. Never hide or auto-enable hardware access.
QUIET_COMPUTE_SCHEDULER: explicit idle-only, AC-only, quiet-hours and optional pause-on-interaction policies enforced locally by the desktop agent.
high_value_findings.benefit: Makes real opt-in compute substantially more practical on personal machines.

high_value_findings.proposal: RESOURCE_SONIFICATION: use the same helios:resource-policy envelope as a presentation-only orchestration input; CPU may bias pulse/rhythm, GPU may bias spectral/air layers, MAX may add a restrained electrical texture.
NON_MONEY_GPU_FIRST_PILOT: connect one approved GPU-friendly workload and measure verified throughput, watt-hours, thermals, reject/retry rate, verifier failures and value per verified unit.
OPTIONAL_ATTESTED_EXECUTION_CHAIN: signed provider manifest + exact artifact digest + agent identity + verifier proof + optional platform/TEE/TPM attestation where available.

COMPUTE_CONSTELLATION: represent explicitly authorized agents as a cosmic constellation with resource class, health, current route and verified work; aggregate by default to minimize device fingerprint leakage.
high_value_findings.benefit: Makes the distributed HELIOS identity visible and understandable.

high_value_findings.proposal: ENERGY_AWARE_SCHEDULING: optional electricity-price/carbon-intensity signal plus local watt budget to delay non-urgent work when energy conditions are poor.
high_value_findings.guardrail: EXTERNAL_SIGNAL_MUST_BE DISCLOSED, FALLIBLE AND NEVER A GAME_INPUT

high_value_findings.finding: PUBLIC_PAGE_CANNOT SHOW WHETHER A REAL GPU PATH IS AVAILABLE
high_value_findings.proposal: PRIVACY_MINIMIZED_CAPABILITY_PROBE: explicit opt-in WebGPU/native-agent availability check reporting only coarse capability classes needed for admission, not a detailed device fingerprint.

high_value_findings.finding: PROFILE_STORES ROUTE HISTORY BUT DOES NOT TURN VERIFIED COMPUTE INTO A COHERENT NON_WAGERING_IDENTITY
high_value_findings.proposal: COMPUTE_PASSPORT: visual receipt/provenance history showing which scientific, render, market or public-good tasks the device helped complete; session/reel palette may decorate it but cannot change value or admission.

high_value_findings.finding: RESOURCE_POLICY_AND_ROUTE_AURA_NOW_SHARE VISUAL STATE BUT SESSION_IDENTITY IS NOT EXPOSED AS A SINGLE COHERENT MANIFEST
high_value_findings.proposal: SESSION_IDENTITY_MANIFEST: one presentation-only object joining mode, route, session seed, Reel Forge palette, music profile and resource aura style for reproducible diagnostics and visual debugging.
high_value_findings.benefit: Makes the procedural system inspectable rather than magical black-box state.

anti_patterns: DO_NOT_ENABLE_GPU_OR OTHER HARDWARE WITHOUT EXPLICIT USER POLICY
DO_NOT_ALLOW CENTRAL CONTROLLER TO WIDEN LOCAL RESOURCE CAPS
DO_NOT_USE DETAILED HARDWARE FINGERPRINTING MERELY FOR DECORATION
DO_NOT_TURN COMPUTE PASSPORT OR IMPACT INTO WAGERING VALUE
conclusion: The largest near-term HELIOS opportunity is not another isolated feature. It is convergence: expose the already-implemented compute capabilities through one explicit resource contract, then let routing, verified receipts and presentation share that contract while game mathematics remains isolated. GPU support, weighted route allocation, resource safety limits and multi-agent fabric are already present deeply enough that the public Router can evolve into a genuine compute cockpit rather than a single CPU slider.
